block_until_dual.name: Dataverse MCP Server
block_until_dual.note: Sales SoR. No Dataverse instance. A quote or order write without two seats is the U-DUAL write that must not happen.

block_until_dual.name: Any BYO MCP that writes Business Central or Sales
block_until_dual.note: Reject on the Requests tab. Do not register an AINav admit MCP that posts journals.

leave_available.name: Work IQ User
leave_available.note: Seat object ids. Not a seat.

leave_available.name: Work IQ Teams
leave_available.note: Notify. A chat is not a seat.

leave_available.name: Work IQ Mail
leave_available.note: Notify only. A mailbox is not a seat.

leave_available.name: Microsoft MCP Management
leave_available.note: Governs tools. Cannot weaken Job C.

note: E7 ships Copilot and Agent 365. The Agents > Tools registry governs MCP servers. A tool invocation is not dual admit.

steps.do: Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center as DayTradingMarkets. Use a role that can manage Agent Tools.
Open Agents > Tools > Registry. The Cloud admin deep link lands on the tools list.
For each Leave Available tool: search the Name, open the row, and leave Status = Available. If it is Blocked, choose Unblock. Available is not a seat.
Confirm these five show Status Available and Publisher Microsoft: Work IQ User, Work IQ Teams, Work IQ SharePoint, Work IQ Mail, Microsoft MCP Management.
Do not bind Microsoft 365 Copilot, Work IQ Copilot, Agent 365, or Work IQ Calendar as seat_a or seat_b. A tool invocation is not dual admit.
Find Dataverse MCP Server. If Status is Available, choose Block. Keep it blocked until paid U-DUAL and dual admit exist.
Open the Requests tab. Reject any BYO MCP that writes Business Central or Sales or claims dual admit. Do not register an AINav admit MCP that posts journals.
Stop. This does not publish the Institute, write a SoR, or mark LIVE_PIN_OK. This Cloud Agent cannot click Unblock or Block.

this_agent_cannot: Sign in to admin.cloud.microsoft as the owner.
Grant Entra consent for an MCP server.
